def clone(self, clone_name):
    clone_id = self.id + "_CLONED." + clone_name
    if clone_id in [card_type.id for card_type in self.card_types()]:
        raise NameError
    clone_name_safe = clone_name.encode('utf8').replace(b" ", b"_").decode('utf8')
    C = type(clone_name_safe, (self.__class__, ),
             {"name": clone_name,
              "is_clone": True,
              "id": clone_id})

    self.component_manager.register(C(self.component_manager))
